title: FM Broadcast Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate broadcast FM-modulated signal, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets Output signal sample rate 240e3; {Frequency deviation (Hz)} sets the peak deviation of the output signal frequency, {De-emphasis filter time constant (s)} sets the de-emphasis lowpass filter time constant, {Output audio sample rate (Hz)}, {Play audio device} sets the play sound using default audio device, {Buffer size (samples)}, {Stereo audio} sets the option to enable stereo demodulation, {RDS/RBDS demodulation} sets the option to enable RDS, {Number of samples per RDS/RBDS symbol} sets the number of samples output per RDS/RBDS, {RDS/RBDS Costas loop} sets the option to enable Costas Loop and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: FM-modulated baseband audio signal column vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: RDS (or RBDS) signal N -element column vector | 2-by- N matrix

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Output signal sample rate 240e3 | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency deviation (Hz)
params.values: Peak deviation of the output signal frequency 75e3 | positive scalar

params.name: De-emphasis filter time constant (s)
params.values: De-emphasis lowpass filter time constant 7.5e-05 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output audio sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Output audio sample rate 48000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Play audio device
params.values: Play sound using default audio device on (default) | off

params.name: Stereo audio
params.values: Option to enable stereo demodulation off (default) | on

params.name: RDS/RBDS demodulation
params.values: Option to enable RDS (or RBDS) waveform demodulation off (default) | on

params.name: Number of samples per RDS/RBDS symbol
params.values: Number of samples output per RDS/RBDS symbol 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: RDS/RBDS Costas loop
params.values: Option to enable Costas Loop off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
